full_details: At the Cross Keys the plot hung on a nail by the parlour door. The watchet gown had come, and Nick moved in it. Augustine Phillips took Sam through the cuckoo song on the breath, not on the word. Sam forgot where to stand and remembered every note. John Sincler came in in black and said the half-line. The ostlers in the gallery stopped forking straw. Kemp was quiet. You said to come slower, then nothing, and to let them do it. The whole comedy ran three hours ten, and Heminges wrote the figure down and underlined it. You went home to pottage, threepence, looked at three cues on the roll, and at two you played. You were back at the lodging after.
one_sentence: Nick wore the watchet, Sam kept every note and lost his place, you told the messenger to come slower and then say nothing, and you played after two.
title: Rehearsed the watchet gown and the cuckoo song
